If the DataStore read -- fails (outage, throttling), the session is flagged and -- saveData() refuses to run -- otherwise a player who joins -- during an outage would overwrite a real balance with the -- 0-Shard fallback. Balances are solvency. -- * Loaded values are clamped to sane ranges before use, so a -- corrupted or hand-edited save can never mint negative or -- astronomical currency into the live economy. local Players = game:GetService("Players") local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService") local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage") local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_v1") local MAX_STAGE = 12 -- Checkpoint_1 .. Checkpoint_12 (Script 5) local function clean(value, fallback, max) value = tonumber(value) if value == nil or value ~= value then return fallback end -- nil / NaN return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, max) end local function loadData(player) -- Up to 3 attempts: a transient DataStore error should not cost -- a player their balance OR lock them out of saving for a session. for _ = 1, 3 do local ok, data = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId) end) if ok then if type(data) == "table" then return { Shards = clean(data.Shards, 0, 1000000000), Blooms = clean(data.Blooms, 0, 100000000), Stage = clean(data.Stage, 0, MAX_STAGE), }, true end return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, true -- new player end task.wait(1) end return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, false end local function saveData(player) if player:GetAttribute("DataSaveDisabled") then return end local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") if not stats then return end local data = { Shards = clean(stats.Shards.Value, 0, 1000000000), Blooms = clean(stats.Blooms.Value, 0, 100000000), Stage = clean(stats.Stage.Value, 0, MAX_STAGE), } -- UpdateAsync, not SetAsync: the write is atomic per key, so two -- servers can never interleave half a save over the other. pcall(function() store:UpdateAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, function() return data end) end) end local function onPlayerAdded(player) local data, loaded = loadData(player) -- Other systems read these two attributes before they grant -- anything.
